messages:
acme_integration: Hey team — noticed a production client receiving SSE for completions that ends in an incomplete JSON payload. The stream stops, no final '}' and finish_reason is missing/null. Causes parser errors downstream. Repro steps below.

acme_integration: Repro (minimal): curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=small-lm" 
Response ends like this: 

data: {"id":"resp_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...final words"}}]

(EOF - no closing ] or finish_reason, client gets JSONDecodeError)

lucy: Thanks — can you paste the full raw bytes (including trailing newlines) or a HAR capture? Also which SDK and client environment?

acme_integration: We're using our Node fetch wrapper + EventSource polyfill, happens in production only when auth rotation occurs. HAR attached (snippet): 

--snip--
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
...
data: {"id":"resp_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...final words"}}]}

<connection closed by client after 1s>
--end snip--

jordan: Noted. Two quick hypotheses: 1) client-side connection closed early due to auth rotation and the server didn't emit terminal event; 2) proxy/load‑balancer cut stream mid-chunk. Do you see 100-continue or any upstream RST in your infra?

acme_integration: We see a short spike in 401 when our token rotates, then our client reconnects using new token. This matches the time of truncated responses.

sre-bot: deploy/rollback: runtime/gw-v2 deployed 2026-03-06T02:43Z to prod (no errors reported).

lucy: Can we reproduce by rotating tokens during an active stream? Jordan, can you try with a synthetic client that closes during auth refresh?

jordan: Reproduced locally. Steps: 
1) Start SSE with curl -N "/streams?model=small-lm&stream=true" 
2) After ~2s, send HTTP/1.1 401 on connection from client (simulate token refresh) 
3) Server stops streaming and connection closes; final event missing. 

Local capture: 

data: {"id":"resp_local","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...near-final"}}]}

[connection teardown] <-- no trailing event, no finish_reason. Parser fails when expecting complete JSON.

support_jen: Workaround for customers: implement client-side tolerance — treat abrupt close as potential finalization and attempt to call non-stream endpoint to fetch last state, or retry the request (idempotency key) to get a complete response. Also add a small buffer read (100ms) after close to consume remaining TCP bytes.

lucy: Thanks. I've opened ENG ticket ENG-4123 and linked the HAR and repro script. Assigning to eng-mike for runtime investigation.

eng-mike: On it. Quick note: server currently relies on graceful flush to send terminal event. If upstream connection resets during auth rotation, flush can be interrupted. We'll add stronger server-side handshake to emit terminal sentinel before closing the socket when possible, and also telemetry to mark interrupted streams as 'incomplete_stream' for easier triage.

eng-mike: For immediate mitigation we can also add a short retry window in the gateway: on mid-stream auth rotation, attempt to finish inflight tokens for 250ms before cutting connection. I'll propose a canary patch.

acme_integration: Appreciate it — ETA for the patch? This is causing ~0.7% of customer completions to fail JSON parsing.

eng-mike: Targeting a rollback-free canary in 48h, full rollout in 5 business days if canary looks good.

support_jen: I'll follow up with the customer with the workaround and keep them updated on ENG-4123. Also suggesting they enable automatic resume headers and idempotency where possible to reduce user-visible failures. :thumbsup:

acme_integration: Thanks everyone. We'll implement the client-side retry as a stopgap and share our deployment timeline.
